🏔️ Kangchenjunga

The third highest mountain in the world at 8,586 m, located on the border between Nepal and Sikkim, India.

properties.name: Guwahati
properties.description:
🌊 Guwahati

The largest city in Assam and the gateway to Northeast India, situated on the south bank of the Brahmaputra river.

  • Population: ~1 million
  • Famous for: Kamakhya Temple, river cruises
  • Climate: Tropical monsoon

properties.name: Assam Region
properties.description:
🌿 Assam

A state in Northeast India, known for its wildlife sanctuaries, tea gardens, and the mighty Brahmaputra river.

Assam produces over 50% of India's total tea output, making it one of the largest tea-growing regions in the world.
